label: Keyspace
type: the addressable unit a SQL++ statement or an index targets - in practice a collection, identified by its bucket.scope.collection path. The term the server/ tree uses where the Capella tree says 'collection'.
note: Promoted as the term that connects this round's data-model vocabulary to the already-large n1ql: family, and because capella:collection's own record already noted the vocabulary mismatch from the other side ('the server/ tree calls the same thing a keyspace'). Object of the scopedToKeyspace predicate promoted this round. Note this is a *near*-synonym, not an identity: index-service.md's cardinality statement writes 'keyspace (collection)', which is the closest the corpus comes to stating the equivalence outright.
